description: Is this PHP install exposed to PHP2Shell, the two critical unauthenticated RCE flaws patched on 21 Oct 2026 (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)? Paste local evidence collected on the server: `php -v`, `php -i` or `php-fpm -i`, `cat /etc/os-release`, `dpkg -l 'php*'` or `rpm -qa 'php*'`. Returns patched / vulnerable / check_vendor_backport, the exact changelog command that decides distribution builds, upgrade commands, config mitigations until patched, and a tested Wazuh rule pack for crash and OOM signals. Free. Nothing is fetched from your servers.
